import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (same penguin measured twice / duplicated record)
    df = df.drop_duplicates(keep='first')
    # Normalize species label variants (strip spaces, fix typo)
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Chinstarp': 'Chinstrap'})
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (sign errors)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Fix out-of-range body mass (value recorded in mg instead of g)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    counts = df.groupby('island')['penguin_id'].count()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
